import html # Predefined HTML template for a blog post. # The placeholders {title} and {body} will be replaced with the escaped user input. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def render_article_page(headline: str, content: str) -> str: """ Render a blog post page from user-supplied title and content. Parameters ---------- headline : str The headline or title of the blog post. content : str The full text content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A sanitized, HTML-formatted string ready for safe display on a webpage. Notes ----- - The function escapes all HTML special characters in both headline and content to prevent injection attacks (CWE-74). - It uses a simple template with placeholders that are replaced after escaping. """ # Escape user input to neutralize any HTML special characters safe_title = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(content, quote=True) # Replace placeholders in the template with the escaped values rendered = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body) return rendered
